caption:
Your follow-up text might look like spam before anyone reads it.

iOS 18 added RCS support to iPhones. Verified business senders show a name and logo instead of a number.

An unverified number shows up as plain text from a stranger.

The fix takes five minutes and costs nothing: add one line to your first automated text. "Save this number as [Your Business Name] so you know it's us."

Then ask your texting provider if they support RCS Business Messaging for the real upgrade.

Check how your own follow-up lands on an iPhone this week. See where your response speed and setup stand.

DM TOOLS.

#ServiceBusiness #LeadFollowUp #SmallBusinessMarketing #HomeServices #CRM
rationale: A verified 2026 texting shift (iOS 18 RCS + verified sender badges) that silently affects reply rates on the exact automated follow-up texts this account teaches, paired with a free five-minute copy fix.
